users.summary: Recorded chats focus on bioinformatics and scientific programming: Rust and parallel processing, genome annotation and sequence workflows, sequencing and transcriptomics, software packaging, and a smaller set of disease-rate and population-data calculations. This describes only the supplied chat sample.

Recorded chats focus on PTA education and clinical preparation, including gait and transfer skills, therapeutic exercise, rehabilitation concepts, assessments, and study quizzes. Many chats also seek help editing emails, clinical writing, and course reflections; this describes only the supplied chat sample.
